name: El Yunque National Forest
description: The only tropical rainforest in the U.S. National Forest System, featuring waterfalls, hiking trails, and diverse wildlife. Perfect for nature lovers and adventure seekers.

Beautiful waterfalls including La Mina Falls
Miles of hiking trails for all skill levels
